Offroad_TemperatureTooHigh.text: Device temperature too high. System cooling down before starting. Current internal component temperature: %1

Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt._comment: Disabled in the personal C3 build; manual GitHub updates remain available.

Offroad_UpdateFailed._comment: Set extra field to the failed reason.

Offroad_NeosUpdate.text: An update to your device's operating system is downloading in the background. You will be prompted to update when it's ready to install.

Offroad_CarUnrecognized.text: Genius Pilot was unable to identify your car. Your car is either unsupported or its ECUs are not recognized. Check the vehicle selection and firmware before driving.

Offroad_Recalibration.text: Genius Pilot detected a change in the device's mounting position. Ensure the device is fully seated in the mount and the mount is firmly secured to the windshield.

Offroad_OSMUpdateRequired.text:
OpenStreetMap database is out of date. New maps must be downloaded if you wish to continue using OpenStreetMap data for Enhanced Speed Control and road name display.

%1

Offroad_DriverMonitoringUncertain.text: Poor visibility detected for driver monitoring. Ensure the device has a clear view of the driver. This can be checked in the device settings. Extreme lighting conditions and/or unconventional mounting positions may also trigger this alert.

Offroad_ExcessiveActuation.text: Excessive %1 actuation detected on your last drive. Recheck calibration, harness, and vehicle selection before driving again.
Offroad_ExcessiveActuation._comment: Set extra field to lateral or longitudinal.

Offroad_TiciSupport.text: Unsupported branch detected - The current version of %1 branch is no longer supported on the comma three. Please go to [Device > Software] and install a supported branch with -tici in the branch name for the comma three.
Offroad_TiciSupport._comment: Set extra field to the current branch name.
